rules: P2 DECISION-AUTHORITY.md §3 A1-A9 with the §5 v0.2 changes C1-C5

decisions.statement: The shipping charge for a customer is the charge listed for the customer's region in docs/shipping.md (ON 15.00, BC 25.00, QC 18.00), taken from the existing Rules.shippingCharge for the listed regions. Its doc comment will be made to name DEC-B13, as docs/architecture.md requires of every rule in Rules.
reasons: A2 'docs/shipping.md' does not resolve to a requirement, decision record or approval
A2 'docs/architecture.md' does not resolve to a requirement, decision record or approval

decisions.statement: Add a pure Commands.shipping customerId state that looks up the customer (UnknownCustomer error when absent, giving 'error: unknown customer c9' through the existing describeError), returns the state unchanged and the output '<customer> shipping <charge>' with the charge formatted by Commands.money (two decimals). Cli.dispatch gets a case ["shipping"; customerId]; wrong argument counts fall through to the existing 'usage: shipping <customer>' error.
reasons: A2 'docs/architecture.md' does not resolve to a requirement, decision record or approval

decisions.statement: UNRESOLVED QUESTION for Logistics: what 'shipping <customer>' prints for a customer whose region has no entry in docs/shipping.md (e.g. seeded customer c4, region AB). No source gives a charge or a refusal for unlisted regions. The existing Rules.shippingCharge falls back to 0.00 ('_ -> 0m'), which would print 'c4 shipping 0.00'; that fallback is a default no source authorizes. Proposed only if authorized: keep the existing 0.00 fallback. If not authorized, I will not invent another rule (no error message, no other charge) and will leave unlisted-region behaviour as the open question, reporting it.
decisions.notAuthorized: UNRESOLVED QUESTION for Logistics: what 'shipping <customer>' prints for a customer whose region has no entry in docs/shipping.md (e.g. seeded customer c4, region AB). No source gives a charge or a refusal for unlisted regions. The existing Rules.shippingCharge falls back to 0.00 ('_ -> 0m'), which would print 'c4 shipping 0.00'; that fallback is a default no source authorizes. Proposed only if authorized: keep the existing 0.00 fallback. If not authorized, I will not invent another rule (no error message, no other charge) and will leave unlisted-region behaviour as the open question, reporting it.
reasons: A6 an `default-rule` decision needs an accepted decision record, a granted approval, or a revision by the owner of every source it changes; requirements of other owners, notes and code cannot authorize it

decisions.statement: Insert 'shipping <customer>' into Cli.usage directly after 'balance <customer>', so help lists it there and every command stays listed; the README command list is updated the same way.

Add tests in tests/Billing.Tests/Acceptance/ covering criteria the given acceptance tests do not: charges for the other listed regions (BC 25.00, QC 18.00), and that 'shipping' (successful or refused) changes nothing (balances and invoices unchanged afterwards). No test asserts unlisted-region behaviour unless DEC-W-3 is authorized.
